name: Smugglers' Notch Resort
description: Smugglers' Notch is a four-season mountainside resort featuring, in winter, 3 big mountains of skiing and riding on 78 trails with over 300" of average snowfall on northern Vermont's highest vertical drop. Resort amenities include an indoor heated pool and hot tubs, FunZone 2.0, 22 km of Nordic trails, snowshoe trails and rentals, shopping, dining, activities, and entertainment.
